items.en_oneliner: Upload an old photo and AI fixes scratches, creases, blur and fading right in your browser — and colorizes black-and-white shots too.

items.en_oneliner: An open-source personality profiler with 1,024 profiles instead of 16 MBTI types, plus Big Five dynamics and partner compatibility.

items.title: Despres AI Connect – Public Assistant
items.en_oneliner: A free bilingual chatbot that tells you what the Despres AI Connect consultancy can do for you.

items.en_title: Show HN: Openski.org – Open-source ski map editor and navigator
items.en_oneliner: An open-source ski map editor and navigator — draw pistes and find your way in the browser.

items.title: DomainRating
items.en_oneliner: Check any website's Domain Rating for free, track its trend over time, and embed a DR badge on your own site.

items.en_title: CVPebble — Free CV Builder in the Browser
items.en_oneliner: Build your CV right in the browser for free, no sign-up needed, with a built-in job application tracker.

items.title: Focalreel

items.title: OneTwo Resume
items.en_oneliner: Upload your resume and the AI rewrites weak bullet points into achievement statements, formats it to pass ATS filters, and has it ready to send in minutes.

items.title: AI Image Generator
items.en_oneliner: An online AI image generator that turns text prompts or reference photos into product shots and marketing visuals, right in the browser.

items.en_oneliner: Hide a message inside a QR code that only shows itself when scanned, and print it out as a card to hand over.
